column1: # The second golden library's text queries in a STRANGER'S wording: the same 29 classes asked for without their names, and the same 18
# no-answer queries as `queries.tsv`. Index and model are unchanged between the two files; only the questions differ.
# Columns (tab-separated, in this order, header required):
#   class        the class whose members are the right answers (golden/kenney/labels.csv), or `-` for a query that should find NOTHING
#   description  the words a person who has not seen the class list would type — `tests/semantic_golden.rs` checks that none of the
#                class's own words (a name's parts of four letters or more) appears in it

# Written at the same time as `queries.tsv`, before the model had run on this library; see its header. Never edit a row in place.
